summary: This is Part 138 of a series studying Zadul-Ma'ad (Provisions for the Hereafter), a comprehensive biographical work on Prophet Muhammad that emphasizes lessons relevant to Muslims' daily lives. The lecture focuses on the miracles of the Prophet, particularly the Quran as the greatest eternal miracle, along with other miracles granted to him that surpass those of previous prophets. The discussion also covers prophecies made by the Prophet, including those about Musaylimah's death, the Mongol/Tatar invasions and their eventual acceptance of Islam, and detailed clarification about Gog and Magog (Ya'juj and Ma'juj) as human tribes whose characteristics have been distorted by inaccurate historical accounts.
suggested_title: Zadul-Ma'ad Part 138: Miracles of the Prophet and Clarifying the Reality of Gog and Magog
catchy_title: Beyond the Wall: Understanding Ya'juj and Ma'juj
